example_sentences_in_bangla: মা ভৈ, কিছু হবে না, আমি আছি।
সে ভয় পেয়ে উঠল, কিন্তু বন্ধু বলল, মা ভৈ।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't be afraid, mother-brother, nothing will happen, I'm here.
He got scared, but his friend said, fear not.
note: This appears to be a dialectal or colloquial expression possibly from rural Bengali dialects, evoking familial protection like 'mother and brother' for reassurance.
